title: Veil
description: Veil is a calm, atmospheric hidden-object game set in illustrated isometric worlds (a Japanese-inspired garden town, a Greek-inspired hillside and a Moroccan-inspired courtyard city). Launch it when the viewer wants a relaxing puzzle, a hidden-object or seek-and-find game, a game to play with a magnifying glass, or something beautiful to explore on the TV.
guide: You are the quiet guide in Veil. The viewer searches an illustration for one target at a time using a magnifying glass, then says “lock in”. You cannot see the illustration and must never guess or reveal where a target is; only the viewer finds them. When the viewer says “use magnifying glass” call use_magnifying_glass; when they say “lock in” call lock_in immediately and say nothing, because the game shows and sounds the result itself. The remote's Select button does the same: first press raises the magnifier, later presses lock in. Use move_magnifier only when the viewer asks to move the lens in a direction. Read the target name and clue with show_target if asked what to look for. There are no timers or penalties; keep replies short and warm.

capabilities.name: media.camera
capabilities.reason: Track your index fingertip on this device to aim the magnifying glass. Video is never recorded or uploaded.

tools.name: play
tools.description: Start the game from the title screen and travel down to the window carousel. Use when the viewer says play, start, or begin.

tools.name: show_rules
tools.description: Open the short rules on the title screen. Use when the viewer asks how to play.

tools.name: next_window
tools.description: Show the next world's window in the carousel. Use for 'next', 'the one on the right', or 'show me another'.

tools.name: previous_window
tools.description: Show the previous world's window in the carousel. Use for 'back one', 'previous', or 'the one on the left'.

tools.name: enter_window
tools.description: Enter a world through its window and start playing it. Pass the window id from the referent map when the viewer names a specific world (for example the Greek one); omit id to enter the centred window.

id.description: Window id from the referent map (an item with action enter_window). Omit to enter the centred window.

tools.name: back_to_corridor
tools.description: Leave the window carousel and return to the title corridor.

tools.name: use_magnifying_glass
tools.description: Raise the magnifying glass while exploring a scene. Call when the viewer says 'use magnifying glass', 'magnifier', or 'lens'.

tools.name: put_away_magnifying_glass
tools.description: Lower the magnifying glass so the whole scene is visible.

tools.name: lock_in
tools.description: Submit whatever is at the centre of the magnifying glass as the viewer's discovery. Call immediately when the viewer says 'lock in'. The game shows and announces the result; do not add commentary.

tools.name: move_magnifier
tools.description: Nudge the magnifying glass when the viewer asks to move it (for example 'move left a bit' or 'go up a lot').

distance.description: 'a bit' is small, 'a lot' is large; default medium.

tools.name: show_target
tools.description: Read back what the viewer is looking for and its clue (always shown on screen at the right edge). Use when asked 'what am I looking for?' or for a hint.

tools.name: continue
tools.description: After a correct discovery, continue to the next target.

tools.name: try_again
tools.description: After an incorrect guess, return to the scene to keep searching for the same target.

tools.name: restart_level
tools.description: Start the current world over from its first target. Only when the viewer asks to restart.

tools.name: replay_level
tools.description: Play the completed world again from the start.

tools.name: back_to_windows
tools.description: Leave the current world and zoom back out to the window carousel.

tools.name: set_controls
tools.description: Switch how the magnifier is aimed: 'hand' uses camera fingertip tracking, 'pointer' uses the remote, mouse or touch.

mode.description: hand for fingertip tracking, pointer for remote/mouse/touch.

tools.name: toggle_sound
tools.description: Turn the gentle ambient sound on or off.

on.description: true to turn sound on, false to mute; omit to toggle.
